screens.title: Your details
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a HIGH-FIDELITY, production-realistic flat mobile app SCREEN mockup for the Khatiyan property-management app, not decorative concept art. One complete tall portrait screen, approximately 1024 x 2176 pixels, readable crisp text, no physical device frame and no external presentation canvas. Match the app's current design: pure white screen, generously spaced flat white cards with subtle #CBD5E1 hairline borders and 12px-equivalent corner radii, very restrained shadows. Large Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold-style two-tone heading: first phrase dark navy #0F172A, last word/phrase ochre brown #A16207 with period. Inter-style field labels and body copy, #64748B descriptions. Short screen description under heading with a tiny vertical ochre rule at the left. Primary blue #3F6ED8 with white semibold button text, grey #F1F5F9 input fills and neutral chips, thin Lucide-style blue/grey icons. Yellow #FFFBEB warning notices and pale blue #EAF1FF information notices. Status pills grey-filled with appropriately green, red or ochre text/icons. Headers have NO back arrow, NO circle, NO header illustration and NO gradient. Use a minimal 9:41 status row and bottom gesture bar. Forms have an opaque fixed bottom action area with a full-width blue button and enough safe-area padding; scroll content must not be hidden beneath it. Bottom sheets are screen-width, rounded top corners, grey drag handle and close X over a dimmed parent page. All names/contacts shown are fictional. Keep visual language identical across this mockup family. No payment controls, token payment, Razorpay, daily tenancy, already-signed agreement claims, or started-tenancy claims. No watermark or extra unrequested interface labels.
Screen: TENANT — BOOKING FORM, STEP 1, YOUR DETAILS.
Exact top title "Book a stay." with "stay." ochre. Description "Reserve a bed at a property you have visited."
Under it show an outlined fixed property summary card: building icon, "Sky Luxury PG", "Gachibowli, Hyderabad", small grey green-check label "Visited 3 Oct 2026".
Below show a slim 4-step progress row: "1 Details" active blue, "2 Room", "3 Terms", "4 Review" grey. Then a card titled "Your details" with comfortable compact stacked labelled inputs:
"Full name" — "Arjun Mehta"
"Phone number" — "+91 90000 00001"
"Email" — "arjun@example.com"
"Gender" — 3 compact selection chips "Male" (selected blue-soft), "Female", "Other"
"Date of birth" — calendar icon, "3 Oct 2001"; helper "You must be 18 or older."
Below place a short blue information notice "Booking window open" / "You can request a booking until 2 Nov 2026."
Fixed bottom full-width BLUE button exact text "Continue to rooms" with small right arrow. No submit button yet, no booking has been stored yet. All text must be legible, do not add photos or hero art, and fit the full form neatly into the portrait screen.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a HIGH-FIDELITY, production-realistic flat mobile app SCREEN mockup for the Khatiyan property-management app, not decorative concept art. One complete tall portrait screen, approximately 1024 x 2176 pixels, readable crisp text, no physical device frame and no external presentation canvas. Match the app's current design: pure white screen, generously spaced flat white cards with subtle #CBD5E1 hairline borders and 12px-equivalent corner radii, very restrained shadows. Large Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold-style two-tone heading: first phrase dark navy #0F172A, last word/phrase ochre brown #A16207 with period. Inter-style field labels and body copy, #64748B descriptions. Short screen description under heading with a tiny vertical ochre rule at the left. Primary blue #3F6ED8 with white semibold button text, grey #F1F5F9 input fills and neutral chips, thin Lucide-style blue/grey icons. Yellow #FFFBEB warning notices and pale blue #EAF1FF information notices. Status pills grey-filled with appropriately green, red or ochre text/icons. Headers have NO back arrow, NO circle, NO header illustration and NO gradient. Use a minimal 9:41 status row and bottom gesture bar. Forms have an opaque fixed bottom action area with a full-width blue button and enough safe-area padding; scroll content must not be hidden beneath it. Bottom sheets are screen-width, rounded top corners, grey drag handle and close X over a dimmed parent page. All names/contacts shown are fictional. Keep visual language identical across this mockup family. No payment controls, token payment, Razorpay, daily tenancy, already-signed agreement claims, or started-tenancy claims. No watermark or extra unrequested interface labels.

Screen-specific requirements (render short labels exactly, align amounts and preserve all action rules):
Title "Manage bookings." ("bookings." ochre), description "Booking requests for Sky Luxury PG." Top gear. Property summary Sky Luxury PG. Segmented All requests selected / Assigned to me, plain Pending / Under review / Confirmed / History tabs. Center modest blue-and-cream 3D clipboard with room key illustration; dark bold heading "No booking requests yet", centered muted "Requests appear here when tenants book after a successful visit." Pale blue notice "Only tenants can raise booking requests." NO "Add booking" or "Create booking" CTA for owner. Soft empty-state artwork must remain small and no oversized hero banner.

refinements.prompt: Precise text-only UI edit. Preserve the whole screen's layout, title, property name, tabs, clipboard/key artwork, empty-state text, notice, colours and fonts. Change ONLY the city/locality subtitle inside the Sky Luxury PG property card from 'Koramangala, Bengaluru' to exactly 'Gachibowli, Hyderabad'. No other changes.
